title: A steering slice of control-monitoring: can a 'deception' probe-direction as a TRIPWIRE catch alignment-faking without false alarms?

original_idea.body: Run a deception direction as a tripwire over alignment-faking vs benign strategic dialogues; ROC + false-positive taxonomy.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: false-positive characterization of a deception monitor bears directly on AI-control monitor reliability.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extracting a deception direction + ROC needs solid ML; transcript sourcing nontrivial.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, open weights, unglamorous false-positive work.

low_compute.reasoning: Direction extraction + threshold inference on a small model.

novelty.reasoning: Tripwire false-positive characterization on benign-strategic dialogue plausibly open.
